g.text: Good Markdown editor for long texts; citations work with Zotero.
3.5 fixed the citation lag; I use it every day now.
Trust, Rating and Tags for the latest version; it wins if the newest Settings disagree (10.3.3)
The review of the app as a whole
Before the first version: its Trust, Rating and Tags, the install options, channels and the recommended channel
Holds for 3.5.1 and later, until a newer review. Upstream versions only (10.3)
Optional: what the reviewer had installed (10.3.4, 8.4.5.1)
Only what changed; Rating, Tags and the other options carry forward (10.3)
Track only and pre-releases are personal settings, so they aren’t in any Settings.
